git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural debt across multiple historical commits
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: POI schemas originally included time for convenience. When timeline.json was added as authoritative scheduling source, sync-agent-data.py was added as band-aid to copy times instead of removing them from POI files.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Clean break: removed time from all 4 POI schemas, deleted sync time injection, rewrote HTML generator to read from timeline.json directly, updated validators and save script. No dual authority remains.
